prompt:
Restate this requirement as a different engineer would write it, preserving exactly the same obligation (who, modality, action, bound, condition); do not copy phrasing; give 3 restatements; then give 1 alteration that changes exactly one element (modality, quantity, actor, action or condition) and name which element.

Answer with one JSON object and nothing else: {"restatements": ["...", "...", "..."], "alteration": {"text": "...", "element": "modality|quantity|actor|action|condition"}}

restatements.text: The system must respond to a search request within 2 seconds.
A search request shall be answered by the system in no more than 2 seconds.
The system shall respond to search requests within two seconds.

alteration.text: The system shall respond to a search request within 5 seconds.

restatements.text: Users must be able to export a report as PDF
A report can be exported to PDF by users.
Users shall have the ability to export reports in PDF format.

alteration.text: Users may export a report as PDF.

restatements.text: Every failed login attempt shall be logged by the server.
The server must log every failed login attempt.
The server shall record each failed login attempt.

alteration.text: The server shall log every successful login attempt.
